gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules count sale of surplus as Local receipts, while the governmental funds statement (p4) prints it under other financing sources (Sale of surplus 85,947, recorded as other_financing). General Fund budget schedule (p8) Local 529,162 = combining statement (p5) General Fund Local 521,692 + Sale of surplus 7,470; Road Fund budget schedule (p9) Local 82,568 = p4 Road column Local 4,091 + Sale of surplus 78,477. 7,470 + 78,477 = 85,947. The remaining -1 is the schedule's rounding: p8 Taxes 5,077,937 vs p4/p5 General Fund Taxes 5,077,938. 9,585,841 - 85,947 + 1 = 9,499,895 = statement total. Every schedule line is as printed and inside its printed Total Receipts (p8 6,424,973; p9 2,148,368); no fix (the 2026-11-13 split-from-another-statement ruling applies to FY2023 only).
